entries.name: ISO 8583
entries.definition: An ISO standard defining the format of messages exchanged between systems that process payment-card transactions.

entries.name: ISO 9000
entries.definition: A family of ISO standards on quality management, which sets out the vocabulary and principles behind ISO 9001.

entries.name: ISO/IEC 27000 series
entries.definition: A family of ISO/IEC standards on information security management, including ISO/IEC 27001 for management systems and ISO/IEC 27002 for controls.

entries.name: ISO/IEC 27001
entries.definition: An ISO/IEC standard that sets requirements for an information security management system, against which organisations can be certified.

entries.name: ISS Environmental Control and Life Support System
entries.definition: The equipment on the International Space Station that supplies breathable air and water, controls temperature and humidity, and handles waste.

entries.name: Issue tracking systems
entries.definition: Software for recording, assigning and following issues such as software bugs, tasks and support requests until they are resolved.

entries.name: IT governance
entries.definition: The structures and processes by which an organisation directs and controls its use of information technology.

entries.name: Itô's lemma
entries.definition: A result in stochastic calculus that gives the change in a function of a random process such as Brownian motion, used in finance to price derivatives.

entries.name: IT security architecture
entries.definition: Designing the structure of controls, systems and policies that protect an organisation's IT environment.

entries.name: IT security documentation
entries.definition: Writing and maintaining the policies, procedures and records that describe an organisation's IT security controls.

entries.name: Ivalua
entries.definition: A cloud spend-management platform for procurement, covering sourcing, contracts, supplier management and purchasing.

entries.name: JaCoCo
entries.definition: A free Java code coverage library that measures how much of a program its tests run.

entries.name: JacORB
entries.definition: An open-source Java implementation of the CORBA object request broker.

entries.name: JAFAN
entries.definition: A series of Joint Air Force-Army-Navy publications on security policy for US Department of Defense special access programs, best known for JAFAN 6/3 on protecting such information in information systems.

entries.name: Jasmine
entries.definition: A behaviour-driven development framework for testing JavaScript code.

entries.name: Java Archive
entries.definition: A file format, based on ZIP, that packages compiled Java classes, resources and metadata into one compressed file.

entries.name: Java Communications API
entries.definition: A Java API, in the javax.comm package, for reading and writing serial and parallel ports.

entries.name: Java Persistence API 2.0
entries.definition: The second version of the Java Persistence API, released as part of Java EE 6, for mapping Java objects to relational database tables; it added the Criteria API for building queries in code.

entries.name: JavaScript engine
entries.definition: A program that parses, compiles and runs JavaScript code, such as V8 in Chrome and Node.js, SpiderMonkey in Firefox and JavaScriptCore in Safari.

entries.name: JavaScriptCore
entries.definition: The JavaScript engine of the WebKit browser engine, used in Safari and available to macOS and iOS apps.

entries.name: JavaServer Faces 2.0
entries.definition: The second major version of JavaServer Faces, the Java framework for building web user interfaces from components, released as part of Java EE 6 with Facelets as its standard view technology.

entries.name: JAX-RPC
entries.definition: A Java API for building and calling web services that use XML-based remote procedure calls, later replaced by JAX-WS.

entries.name: JAX-WS
entries.definition: The Java API for XML Web Services, which uses annotations to build and call SOAP web services.
variants: Java API for XML Web Services

entries.name: JD Edwards CNC
entries.definition: Administering the technical environment of Oracle's JD Edwards EnterpriseOne ERP software, known as Configurable Network Computing, including installing, configuring, upgrading and tuning it.

entries.name: JdbcTemplate
entries.definition: A class in the Spring Framework that simplifies database access with JDBC by handling connections, statements and exceptions.

entries.name: JDesktop Network Components
entries.definition: A Sun Microsystems SwingLabs project of components for building data-oriented Java Swing desktop applications.

entries.name: Jersey
entries.definition: An open-source Java framework, the reference implementation of JAX-RS, for building RESTful web services.

entries.name: Jive Software
entries.definition: Enterprise collaboration software that gives an organisation an internal social network for sharing content and discussion.

entries.name: jMock
entries.definition: A Java library for testing with mock objects, which lets a test state the calls it expects an object to receive.

entries.name: JMockit
entries.definition: A Java library for mocking objects, including static methods and constructors, in unit tests.

entries.name: Job scheduling
entries.definition: Setting up, running and monitoring automated jobs, such as nightly batch runs, with a scheduler.

entries.name: Joint Clearance and Access Verification System
entries.definition: The application in the US Department of Defense's Joint Personnel Adjudication System that security managers use to verify and record personnel security clearances and access.
variants: Joint Clearance And Access Verification Systems

entries.name: Joint Commission standards
entries.definition: Accreditation standards for US hospitals and other health-care organisations, set by The Joint Commission (formerly JCAHO) to judge quality and patient safety.

entries.name: JointJS
entries.definition: A JavaScript library for building interactive diagrams and visual editors in the browser.

entries.name: Joomla
entries.definition: An open-source content management system, written in PHP, for building and managing websites.

entries.name: JPEG
entries.definition: A widely used standard for compressing photographs, from the Joint Photographic Experts Group, that makes small image files by discarding some detail.

entries.name: JSData
entries.definition: A framework-agnostic JavaScript library for managing application data in a client-side store.

entries.name: JSFiddle
entries.definition: An online editor for writing, running and sharing snippets of HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

entries.name: jsGrid
entries.definition: A lightweight jQuery plugin for showing and editing data in a table-like grid with sorting, filtering and paging.

entries.name: JSON Web Token
entries.definition: A compact, URL-safe token format, defined in RFC 7519, for passing claims between parties as a signed or encrypted JSON object, commonly used for authentication.
